description: This file defines the PHP class UpgradeMetaHelper that provides utilities for managing module upgrades, metadata parsing, module modification detection, and directory management within the SuiteCRM ecosystem.

classes.name: UpgradeMetaHelper
classes.description: A utility class for managing module upgrade processes, including parsing metadata, detecting modifications, and handling directory structures within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing upgrade directories, modules, and parsers based on passed parameters.

methods.name: getModifiedModules
methods.description: Returns modules with files modified based on MD5 checksum comparisons.

methods.name: saveMatchingFilesQueries
methods.description: Stores file queries results in a temporary cache file.

methods.name: getAllCustomizedModulesBeyondStudio
methods.description: Detects modules with customized files beyond Studio modifications by comparing MD5 checksums.

methods.name: getAllCustomizedModules
methods.description: Returns modules with customized files by comparing current files MD5 with base MD5.

methods.name: loadStudioModules
methods.description: Loads modules that have Studio metadata enabled by checking for a specific file.

methods.name: runParser
methods.description: Initializes and runs metadata parsers for modules to upgrade.

methods.name: parseFile
methods.description: Parses individual module files such as EditView, DetailView, and SearchForm for metadata updates.

methods.name: create_upgrade_directory
methods.description: Creates the necessary directory structure to house upgrade modules and copies files.

methods.name: verifyMetaData
methods.description: Performs quick checks to verify metadata file structure for a module's view.
